title: FLA binary import: sharedUrl not decoded from Contents stream for importForRuntimeSharing symbols
description: The model's LibrarySymbol has sharedUrl field but flash8-import.ts never sets it. When importForRuntimeSharing=true, the Contents stream should have the source URL. Research: parseFla8Contents in flash8-binary.ts already reads importForRuntimeSharing flag (4 bytes after linkageIdentifier). The 5th field after the 4 flags should be the sharedUrl string. Check the binary layout of the Contents stream symbol entry: after exportInFirstFrame, exportForActionScript, exportForRuntimeSharing, importForRuntimeSharing flags, is there a BomString for the source URL? If so, decode it and forward through flash8-import.ts to LibrarySymbol.sharedUrl.
